title: Learning by Trial
ends_with: Controllers learned from reward, with the costs of learning by trial counted: a task written as states, actions and rewards, the best policy when the model is known, Q-learning from trying, exploring enough to find what is worth finding, a reward that says what is wanted and one that is gamed, gains for a pole on a cart found by trying them, a policy gradient and what a baseline does to its noise, a controller trained over a spread of robots, and a shield and a release check for what was learned
